lessons: Attempt 1 changed no files and stopped after about 20s of inspection. Redo the whole refactor of clutch/__main__.py and finish it in one run. Do not return incomplete before the edits and the ## Verification commands have run.

Add one async lock wrapper (e.g. _locked) that looks up Lockfile in module globals at call time, then route all seven Lockfile( sites through it, _control included. _retro and _control keep their LockHeld fallbacks. tests/unit/test_lock_holder.py swaps entry.Lockfile.

Add one engine-submit helper that calls _require_engine, then control.read_active (ValueError becomes Refusal 'current control identity unavailable'), then control.publish_request. Also add one observe.Context builder and one load_config reloader lambda.

Add one error printer, _fail(verb, msg), that writes 'clutch <verb>: <msg>' to stderr and returns runner.EXIT_REFUSED. Use it in main's except clauses and in the covgate (x2) and stats prints. Leave the probe unknown-providers print and the issue config warning as they are.

Split main's verb branches into handlers grouped as utilities/projections/authoring/control/lock holders, dispatched from a table. Keep every name in the preserved list. Write tests/unit/test_main_verb_groups.py (printer, lock wrapper on tmp_path) and the integration file for ACs 1-6.
